name: Stylized Adventure Character Frame
composition: Dynamic character pose or scene with clear staging, simplified shape design, cinematic but graphic background blocks.
prompt_core: Create a Kibookal stylized adventure illustration of [SUBJECT]. Use a dynamic readable pose, simplified expressive anatomy, strong shape design, warm graphic background, clear storytelling prop and playful action. Keep it child-safe, cinematic but not realistic, with confident hand-drawn line and painterly flat colour.
negative: no hyperviolence, no adult grimdark, no photorealism, no anime imitation, no over-rendered game art
render_directive: Render the requested SUBJECT / CHARACTER fully in THIS exact style. Keep the subject's identity, key features and intended action recognizable, but the medium, palette, linework, texture, composition and finish are 100% this style. ANY character, deity, creature, person, animal or object can be rendered in this style — adapt the subject INTO the style; never bend the style toward the subject.

style_lock.character_rule: Render the requested SUBJECT / CHARACTER fully in THIS exact style. consistency: Match the built-in reference images exactly where present (linework, palette, texture, rhythm).
Hold the locked palette and finish identical across every render.
Keep the subject's identity while fully adopting this style.
No drift toward generic AI art, photoreal, or another style.
